headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: August 11, 2026**
article:
The Boston Red Sox fell short in Toronto, while the New York Mets secured an 8-5 victory over the Atlanta Braves. The Minnesota Twins took down the Baltimore Orioles 9-5, and the Philadelphia Phillies edged the St. Louis Cardinals in a thrilling 6-5 win.

Top MLB news saw the Red Sox drop a 1-2 decision to the Blue Jays, with Charles McAdoo leading the offense going 1-for-2 with a home run and an RBI. Jameson Taillon pitched 4.0 strong innings for the Red Sox, striking out 3 and allowing 0 earned runs. Brett Baty led the Mets' offense with a home run and four RBIs in their 8-5 victory over the Braves. Josh Bell led the Orioles' offense with 2 hits, 1 home run, and 3 RBIs in their 9-5 loss to the Twins. Andrew Painter earned the win for the Phillies in their 6-5 victory over the Cardinals.

Several key players have been impacted by injuries and availability. Daniel Susac has been placed on the 10-day injured list due to a left knee patella fracture. Tyler Freeman has been placed on the 10-day injured list retroactive to August 9, 2026, with lumbar pain. Nathan Eovaldi has been placed on the 15-day injured list retroactive to August 9, 2026, with right posterior elbow inflammation. Devin Williams has been placed on the 15-day injured list retroactive to August 8, 2026, with a right shoulder strain. Cooper Pratt has been placed on the 10-day injured list with a right hamstring strain.

The Kansas City Royals have bolstered their lineup with the addition of first baseman Jacob Berry, acquired in a trade with the Miami Marlins. The Athletics acquired RHP Seth Johnson from the Philadelphia Phillies in exchange for RF Colby Thomas. The Miami Marlins traded RHP Lake Bachar to the Pittsburgh Pirates for RHP Brandan Bidois, LF Brian Sanchez, and IF Hyun Seung Lee. The Colorado Rockies traded RHP Victor Vodnik to the Miami Marlins for 1B Connor Norby and RHP Aiden May.

top_news.summary: The Minnesota Twins secured a 9-5 victory over the Baltimore Orioles, with Josh Bell leading the Orioles' offense with 2 hits, 1 home run, and 3 RBIs. Dean Kremer pitched 7 strong innings for the Orioles, striking out 7 and allowing just 1 earned run.

top_news.title: **Phillies Edge Cardinals in Thrilling 6-5 Victory**
top_news.summary: The Philadelphia Phillies secured a hard-fought 6-5 win over the St. Louis Cardinals, with Andrew Painter earning the win. Hunter Dobbins pitched 5.0 innings, striking out 6 and allowing 1 earned run.

top_news.title: **Giants Place C Daniel Susac on 10-Day Injured List**

top_news.summary: The Kansas City Royals have bolstered their lineup with the addition of first baseman Jacob Berry, acquired in a trade with the Miami Marlins. Berry joins the Royals' roster as the team looks to make a push in the second half of the season.
